summary: Frontend-only test of the new 'Totales por variedad (todas las fechas)' consolidated card in PlantacionDetail → Cosechas tab. All 6 acceptance criteria PASSED: card exists with correct testids, columns, rows and footer; values are correct (albion=40, san andreas=12, Total general=52.00 cestas); filter independence verified (variedad=albion and periodo=año do not affect the consolidated card — still shows both rows); kg toggle multiplies x14 correctly (albion=560 kg, san andreas=168 kg); cross-date sum verified by creating an additional albion harvest in lote l1 on 2024-07-15 with 7 cestas → albion total went 40→47 in the consolidado and 560→658 in kg. Test data was cleaned up (deleted) and totals restored to baseline (40.00).

issues: Recurring console warnings: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Recharts ResponsiveContainer container has no size during initial render. Cosmetic only — chart renders correctly afterwards. Consider adding minWidth/minHeight or fixed size.

critical_code_review_comments: PlantacionDetail.jsx is 740+ lines; consider splitting CosechasTab into a separate file.
consolidado total testid uses raw variedad string (e.g. 'plant-consolidado-total-san andreas') — works but a slug would be more robust if variedads contained special characters.
Recharts ResponsiveContainer in Calidades del lote occasionally renders with 0 width (console warnings on every nav).
seed_data_creation: Created a temporary cosecha (l1, Fresa/albion, 7 cestas 1ª, fecha 2024-07-15) to validate cross-date sum. DELETED after verification — DB restored to original state (Cosechas · 2, Total 52.00 cestas).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature works end-to-end. consolidado uses 'items' (unfiltered) and respects unidadVista. Verified totals: albion 20+10+5+5=40, san andreas 5+4+2+1=12, Total general 52.00. KG conversion factor KG_POR_CESTA=14 confirmed (40→560, 12→168, 47→658).
rca of the issue: No bug found. Implementation in /app/frontend/src/pages/PlantacionDetail.jsx lines 511-526 correctly iterates over the unfiltered 'items' array, groups by tipo+variedad, applies multDe (unit-aware multiplier), and renders independently of the filters that affect itemsF.
